spec.goal: Execute XY-153 by making freeze entry feel immediate on macOS via a preview-first frozen frame while keeping the authoritative full capture asynchronous.
success_criteria: A valid saved plan/1 artifact exists for XY-153 and is used as the execution authority for this lane.
Freeze entry can show a frozen preview immediately from the current live ScreenCaptureKit frame instead of waiting for the authoritative full-monitor capture to complete.

During live dragged-region selection, the overlay uses a dimmed-outside scrim affordance from drag start onward instead of a full-border flow ring, while hovered-window live flow feedback stays intact.
The authoritative full capture still runs asynchronously and replaces the preview cleanly when it arrives.
The frozen preview appears immediately while export and scroll-start actions stay gated until the authoritative final capture is ready, so provisional preview pixels are not treated as final output.
The frozen toolbar can appear during the preview-first transition without treating final-capture-dependent actions as ready before the authoritative image arrives.
During the preview-to-final transition, frozen HUD and loupe helper windows continue to track cursor movement without the extra delayed jump that was visible after drag release.
Window-freeze and drag-region freeze continue to converge on the existing final capture path without regressing XY-152 frozen scrim behavior.
Verification covers the new freeze-preview path and the touched overlay surface stays green.
constraints: Keep the implementation scoped to the macOS freeze-entry path, live-stream snapshot access, and related overlay state/tests unless verification proves a tighter dependency.
Keep hovered-window live flow feedback unchanged; only dragged-region live affordance should switch to scrim semantics.

Do not replace the authoritative full-monitor path with SCScreenshotManager captureImage(filter:configuration:) in this issue because local measurement shows it is slower than the current warm CGDisplayCreateImage path on this machine.
Treat SCScreenshotManager captureImage(in:) as a future guarded follow-up only; do not raise the supported macOS floor to 15.2 in this issue.
Preserve the existing async final-capture behavior and window matte composition pipeline.
Keep copy/save/scroll actions gated until the authoritative final capture is ready even if the frozen toolbar becomes visible earlier during the preview-first transition.
Use repo-native Rust verification plus a manual freeze-entry smoke check note before claiming completion.

defaults.chosen_strategy: preview-first from the latest live ScreenCaptureKit frame, then async authoritative full capture replacement
